title: Regression with joinedload() on 1.4

labels.name: regression
labels.description: something worked and was broken by a change

labels.name: with_entities change
labels.description: issues related to the altered behvaior of Query w/ 1.4/2.0

body:
**Describe the bug**

I am unable to call `.joinedload()` and `.count()` at the same time with SQLAlchemy 1.4. It affects Flask-SQLAlchemy, as `.paginate()` is broken (https://github.com/pallets/flask-sqlalchemy/issues/910)

**To Reproduce**
```py
from sqlalchemy import (
    Column,
    ForeignKey,
    Integer,
    String,
    create_engine,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import (
    joinedload,
    relationship,
    sessionmaker,
)
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base

Base = declarative_base()
engine = create_engine('sqlite:///:memory')
Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)


class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'users'

    def __repr__(self):
        return 'User %s' % self.id

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    parent_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('users.id'))
    parent = relationship('User', remote_side=[id], lazy='raise')

Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
session = Session()

u = User()
session.add(u)
session.commit()

u2 = User(parent=u)
session.add(u2)
session.commit()

query = session.query(User).options(joinedload(User.parent))
query.count()
```
